proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9757 matsara explicitly gives Sindhi macharu, Lahnda macchur, northern macchar and Gujarati machrũ mosquito/gnat. The entry discusses but does not establish a deeper connection with makṣa; this link does not settle it or local transmission. Exact response: motʃəɽ.
